THIS PROJECT ORDER IS TO PROVIDE TECHNICAL AND BUSINESS SUPPORT TO DOMESTIC ORGANIZATIONS THAT ARE BRINGING TECHNOLOGIES TO MARKET THAT ALIGN WITH DOE AREAS OF INTEREST. THE PRIMARY PARTICIPANTS FOR THIS PROGRAM ARE ORGANIZATIONS THAT DO NOT HAVE THE RESOURCES OR EXPERTISE NEEDED TO ADVANCE THEIR TECHNOLOGIES AND BUSINESSES TO THE NEXT LEVEL. THROUGH THIS PROGRAM, BUSINESSES AND OTHER RELEVANT ENTITIES WILL BE PROVIDED AN OPPORTUNITY TO WORK WITH THIRD-PARTY ORGANIZATIONS TO ADDRESS SPECIFIC COMMERCIALIZATION BARRIERS THEY FACE AS THEY DEVELOP THEIR TECHNOLOGY AND GROW THEIR BUSINESS.
